# Dependency and task amendment — 2026-10-09

Reviewed all 96 remaining units. Preserved 68 accepted units. 164 units become 185; all original obligations retain mapped owners.

## Critical order

003: runtime contract → worker transport → budget → lifecycle dispatcher → stage admission → lineage → prediction/checks → report bindings → exposure/replacement → durable finalization → runtime composition → CLI → integration fixtures → full verification.

015: compatibility → production reuse with cold/warm tests → drift/refresh → lifecycle → full verification.

023: registry scaffold → projection with timeline tests → production hooks/command → repeat orientation → full verification.

018: pre-batch validation → worker batch → scoring → release → complete evidence.

99: inventory → integrated/live journeys → quickstart → complete evidence matrix → release.

task-handoffs.json records consumed and produced symbols, producers, ownership, acceptance and later owners. Source/export availability probes run before admission; behavioral checks remain required. Shared-file work stays serialized. Product requirements and full acceptance are unchanged. Source snapshots and mappings in dependency-replan.json preserve the exact prior obligations. Runtime tasks are amended only through the CLI; accepted task state and historical attempt counters remain intact.
